sloka: त्वचा प्रधानया हि एष मृगो अद्य न भविष्यति ।अप्रमत्तेन ते भाव्यम् आश्रमस्थेन सीतया ॥३-४३-४९॥
transliteration: tvacā pradhānayā hi eṣa mṛgo adya na bhaviṣyati ।apramattena te bhāvyam āśramasthena sītayā ॥3-43-49॥

translations.english: Keep vigil over Sita at the hermitage, O Lakshmana I will certainly kill the speckled antelope with a single arrow, get his skin and come back quickly.
